Assign Help Info to VIs.vi

Owning Palette: VI Helpeks API

The VI saves the help information to the specified source VIs and palettes (.mnu files). Files other than VIs or palettes are ignored.

Click the parameters for details

 

Save to Palettes specifies whether to save help information to palette menus. Default is TRUE.
Save to VIs specifies whether to save help information to VIs. Default is TRUE.
Source File Paths specifies the paths to source files for which help is generated. Files other than VIs or palettes (.mnu files) are ignored.
Source Files Help Info specifies help information for the Source File Paths.
Help Path specifies the help file path that will be applied to the Help path VI property.
Help Tag specifies the value that will be applied to the Help tag VI property.
Abs Help Path indicates the absolute path to the help file.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
dup Source File Paths returns the same value as Source File Paths.
dup Source Files Help Info returns the same value as the Source Files Help Info.
Help Path indicates the help file path that is applied to the Help path VI property.
Help Tag indicates the value that is applied to the Help tag VI property.
Abs Help Path indicates the absolute path to the help file.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
